assessment: This study examines the potential role host proteases involved in coagulation may play in proteolytic processing of the SARS CoV-2 virus spike protein, which is required for viral entry. Serine protease inhibitors such as nafamostat and camostat may limit viral entry into host cells and also be useful to treat coagulopathy in patients with SARS CoV-2 infection, particularly if treatment is initiated early.
